name: Stairs and seating
_about: STEPS, as a cross-section swept: a flight is one with a 30cm tread and an 18cm rise, a tier of seating the same shape with a metre-deep tread and half a metre of rise. Here a straight flight, and beside it the seating it is the small cousin of.
_build: which parts to build, and in what order (a caller may ask for a few of them: the village takes a cathedral's arcades from a definition whose walls it builds itself)
